# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Friday, November 13, 2026

Morning edition for Friday, 13 November 2026 (IST). Covers Thursday 12 Nov and overnight. Stock and index closes are Thursday's NSE files.

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

### Manappuram's Q2: gold AUM up 6.4% in the quarter, profit ₹701 crore
Manappuram Finance reported consolidated Q2 FY27 profit of ₹701 crore, up 19.9% on the quarter and 222.9% on the year, with consolidated gold-loan AUM of ₹60,640 crore, up 6.4% QoQ and 92.5% YoY. Standalone gross Stage 3 was 1.80% at 30 September, and the standalone LTV slipped to 64.5% from 65.6% in June.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: this is the first full set of gold-lender numbers since gold began falling this week, and other gold lenders' Q2 numbers, including Muthoot Fincorp's, will be read against it. Manappuram's gold book grew faster than its tonnage (6.4% against 3.5%), so a good part of the growth came from higher gold prices and bigger tickets, which is the part a falling gold price reverses.
Sources: [NSE: results](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_12112026164223_MAFILOUTCOMEFINAL.pdf) · [NSE: investor deck](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_12112026164750_IPmerged.pdf) · [NSE: press release](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_12112026195139_PressReleaseFinal.pdf) · [CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/earnings/manappuram-finance-q2-net-profit-more-than-doubles-to-rs701-crore-nii-rises-45pc-20032930.htm)

### Gold hits a 13-month low and AGLOC cuts the 85% ceiling by ₹227 a gram
AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for 13 Nov is ₹10,720 a gram, down from ₹10,947 on 12 Nov, on a jewellery reference price of ₹12,612 (was ₹12,879). IBJA's 12 Nov PM rate for 999 gold was ₹1,37,692 per 10 g, and Reuters had spot gold down 2.7% at $3,880.93 an ounce on Thursday afternoon in New York, its lowest since October 2025, as oil rose and traders priced an 87% chance of a December Fed hike.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the industry's 85% per-gram ceiling on fresh gold loans drops by ₹227 from today, the biggest single-day cut this month, and the ceiling is now ₹293 below the 7–11 Nov level. Loans written at last week's ceiling now sit close to their cap.
Sources: [AGLOC](https://www.agloc.org/) · [IBJA](https://ibjarates.com/) · [Mint (Reuters)](https://www.livemint.com/market/gold-drops-to-over-one-year-low-as-fading-middle-east-peace-hopes-fan-inflation-fears-11794511222562.html) · [ET Now](https://www.etnownews.com/markets/gold-price-today-november-13-gold-trades-below-3900-as-us-dollar-hits-52-week-high-fed-rate-hike-bets-remain-firm-article-156501212)

### RBI is drafting curbs on private equity control of more than one NBFC, Reuters reports
RBI is working on proposals to stop a private equity firm holding a controlling stake in more than one NBFC, two people told Reuters; holdings of 15% or less would be treated as financial investments with lighter scrutiny. A draft would go out for public consultation, and the rules could be issued early next year, one source said; RBI did not comment.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: this is a press report, not an RBI instrument. If it goes through, PE money can still come in as minority stakes of 15% or less, which is the size most IPO anchor and pre-IPO investors take, but a fund that already controls another NBFC couldn't take control of a second one.
Sources: [Mint (Reuters)](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/india-plans-curbs-on-private-equity-ownership-of-nbfcs-report-11794472084478.html) · [Economic Times (Reuters)](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/economy/finance/rbi-plans-curbs-on-private-equity-firms-controlling-stakes-in-multiple-non-bank-lenders-report/articleshow/135763029.cms)

## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market


### BusinessLine: Muthoot Fincorp's DRHP shows borrowing cost down 121 bp to 9.11% in FY26
BusinessLine, citing the IPO draft prospectus, reports that Muthoot Fincorp's average cost of borrowing fell to 9.11% in FY26 from 10.32% in FY25, with overseas borrowings at 9.20% of total borrowings in March 2026 (1.65% in March 2024) and commercial paper at 8.92%. It puts bank term loans at 39.69% of borrowings, average loan yield at 21.38% (22.47% in FY25) and net interest margin at 12.80%.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: these DRHP numbers are what investors and the press will set against Manappuram's Q2 deck, where consolidated ECB and USD bonds are 19.3% of borrowings.
Sources: [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/news/muthoot-fincorp-diversifies-funding-to-trim-borrowing-cost/article71695055.ece) · [Business Today](https://www.businesstoday.in/markets/story/muthoot-fincorp-looks-beyond-gold-loans-with-rs3000-crore-ipo-565234-2026-11-02)

### Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
No change since 12 Nov: Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs are trading on BSE in the "F" group, and no final allotted amount had appeared in a published source by this morning.
| Field | Value | As of |

| Status | Closed, 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026; admitted to dealings on BSE from 11 Nov 2026, "F" group ([BSE notice](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)) | 2026-11-13 |
| Size | ₹500 crore (₹200 crore base + ₹300 crore green shoe); final allotted amount not seen in a published source | 2026-11-13 |
| Rating | CRISIL AA/Stable; Brickwork AA+/Stable | 2026-11-13 |
| Coupon | 8.56%–9.25% | 2026-11-13 |
| Bids | Bids stood at 2.67x at 17:00 IST on 5 Nov (BSE: 266.83% of base) ([BSE bid data](https://beta.bseindia.com/markets/publicIssues/DisplayIPO.aspx?IPONo=8058&id=4903&idtype=1&startdt=23%2FOct%2F2026&status=L&type=DPI)) | 2026-11-05 |
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: the deemed date of allotment and the final allotted amount had not been seen in a published source as of this edition.
Sources: [BSE notice 20261109-30](https://www.bseindia.com/downloads/UploadDocs/Notices/20261109-30/20261109-30.pdf)

Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, closed at ₹170.18 on Thursday, up 5.24%, the day it filed its Q2 call transcript ([NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_12112026.csv) · [NSE: transcript](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/muthootmicrofin_12112026141845_InvestorCallTranscriptQ2FY202627SD.pdf)).

## 📈 Market & Stock Summary

### Financials lead a flat market; Shriram and Bajaj Finance gain over 3%
The Sensex rose 31.61 points to 81,911.01 and the Nifty 50 gained 0.18% to 25,299.35 on Thursday, while Nifty Financial Services added 1.42% to 28,057.15. Among peers, Shriram Finance closed at ₹1,003.80 (+3.58%), Bajaj Finance at ₹1,115.00 (+3.36%), Muthoot Finance at ₹2,932.90 (+1.13%), Manappuram at ₹319.95 (−0.02%, before its results) and IIFL at ₹663.15 (−0.47%); NSE's provisional data show FIIs net bought ₹7,830.60 crore and DIIs net sold ₹6,331.17 crore.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: financials outran the index for a second day even as gold fell, so the market isn't yet marking down lenders for the gold move. The rupee weakened 33 paise to 94.04.
Sources: [NSE index closes](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/indices/ind_close_all_12112026.csv) · [NSE bhavcopy](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/products/content/sec_bhavdata_full_12112026.csv) · [NSE FII/DII](https://www.nseindia.com/reports/fii-dii) · [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-12-november-2026/article71689385.ece)

## 🏛️ RBI & Regulatory — Headlines Only

### No new NBFC circular on 12 Nov; RBI refreshes its NBFC FAQs
RBI issued no notification on 12 Nov; its NBFC FAQ page "All you wanted to know about NBFCs" now reads "Updated as on November 11, 2026". RBI also set the final redemption price of SGB 2018-19 Series III at ₹14,024 a unit, the average of IBJA's 999 closes for 10–12 Nov. Details in today's regulation report.
Sources: [RBI FAQs](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/FAQView.aspx?Id=92) · [RBI: SGB redemption price](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63964)

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

Manappuram's Q2 is the lead story above, with the full Peer Intelligence block below.

## 🔍 Peer Intelligence

### Manappuram Finance Q2 FY27 results
Manappuram's standalone gold-loan AUM rose 6.3% in the quarter to ₹58,097 crore and standalone profit rose 20.5% to ₹665 crore. Standalone gross NPA edged up to 1.8% from 1.6%, while CRAR rose to 22.4%.

Not disclosed this quarter: Credit cost; NIM.
Other figures (the call transcript had not been filed by this morning): standalone LTV was 64.5% (65.6% in Q1) and the Reg 52(4) annexure puts standalone gross Stage 3 at 1.80%, net Stage 3 at 1.22% and provision coverage at 32.69% ([deck p.20](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_12112026164750_IPmerged.pdf) · [results p.10](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/MANAPPURAM_12112026164223_MAFILOUTCOMEFINAL.pdf)). Consolidated gold AUM was ₹60,640 crore and consolidated PAT ₹701 crore; the board declared an interim dividend of ₹1 a share, record date 18 Nov.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: Manappuram grew its gold book 6.3% in the quarter while gross NPA rose only slightly and LTV fell, a reference point for Muthoot Fincorp's own Q2 numbers, which fall due by 14 Nov under SEBI LODR Reg 52.

## ⚠️ Credit Rating Actions

No significant developments today on Muthoot Fincorp or the gold-loan peers.

## 🔄 Deals & M&A

### Aditya Birla Capital opens its 100th gold-loan branch, targets 1,000+ in three years
Aditya Birla Capital opened its 100th dedicated gold-loan branch, in Santacruz, Mumbai, about three months after entering the business, and repeated its plan for 200–300 branches by March 2027 and more than 1,000 within three years. Its gold-loan AUM was ₹200 crore at 30 September.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: another well-funded group lender is building a branch-led gold franchise, starting in Maharashtra, which the release says produced 5.8% of India's gold-loan originations in 2025. It's small today, but it competes for the same branch staff and customers Muthoot Fincorp serves outside Kerala.
Sources: [NSE: ABCL press release](https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/ABCAPITAL_12112026151705_SE_Intimation_PressRelease_Signed.pdf)

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

Manappuram's standalone gross NPA moved to 1.8% from 1.6% in the quarter; details in Peer Intelligence above.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Friday: gold loans after the price fall

Three gold-loan data points landed on Thursday: Manappuram's Q2, AGLOC's lowest per-gram ceiling this month and a new branch-led entrant in Aditya Birla Capital. Together they show a market where volumes are still growing (Manappuram's tonnage +3.5% QoQ) but the price tailwind behind AUM has turned. The SGB final redemption price of ₹14,024 a unit, set from IBJA closes for 10–12 Nov, shows how quickly the fall flows into official reference prices.

# 📋 NBFC Regulatory Daily Report
**Date:** Friday, 13 November 2026 (IST)

---

## 🔔 New Regulatory Updates Today

No new RBI, SEBI, IBBI or NHB instrument for NBFCs on 12 Nov. Two things are still worth knowing: RBI refreshed its NBFC FAQ page, and Reuters reports RBI is drafting limits on private equity control of NBFCs.

### RBI refreshes its "All you wanted to know about NBFCs" FAQs
RBI's NBFC FAQ page now carries the line "Updated as on November 11, 2026". It covers registration under Section 45-IA, the ₹10 crore net owned fund floor (existing NBFCs have until 31 March 2027), scale-based layers, lending against shares at a 50% LTV, and the April 2026 Type I / Unregistered Type I NBFC framework.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no new obligation for NBFCs. The FAQ restates existing rules; this edition did not compare it line by line with the previous version, so it reads as a refresh unless RBI flags a change.
Sources: [RBI FAQs](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/FAQView.aspx?Id=92)

### Watch item: RBI drafting curbs on private equity control of more than one NBFC (Reuters)
Two people told Reuters that RBI is working on proposals to stop a private equity firm holding a controlling stake in more than one NBFC, with holdings of 15% or less treated as financial investments. A draft would go to public consultation first. This is a press report, not an RBI instrument, and RBI did not comment.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: nothing changes until RBI publishes a draft. Under the existing Acquisition of Shareholding or Control Directions, 2025, any acquisition of control of an NBFC, or of 26% or more of its equity, already needs RBI's prior approval ([RBI Directions](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewMasDirections.aspx?id=12964)).
Sources: [Mint (Reuters)](https://www.livemint.com/industry/banking/india-plans-curbs-on-private-equity-ownership-of-nbfcs-report-11794472084478.html) · [Economic Times (Reuters)](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/economy/finance/rbi-plans-curbs-on-private-equity-firms-controlling-stakes-in-multiple-non-bank-lenders-report/articleshow/135763029.cms)

### Watchlist sweep: nothing new for NBFCs on 12 Nov
RBI's 12 Nov releases were liquidity operations (VRRR auctions), a ₹34,000 crore G-sec underwriting auction, ECB/FCCB data for September and the SGB 2018-19 Series III final redemption price of ₹14,024 a unit. SEBI's items were the Niveshak Shivir notice and appeal orders. NHB's latest posting is an 11 Nov procurement RFP, and the IBBI site was last updated 10 Nov. FIU-IND was not re-checked for this edition.
Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp: no direct change. The dates still open are the 14 Nov Reg 52 results, the 21 Nov Credit Risk-o-Meter start and the 26 Nov PSL comment deadline.

cards.title: Manappuram's Q2: gold AUM up 6.4% in the quarter, profit ₹701 crore
cards.summary: Manappuram Finance reported consolidated Q2 FY27 profit of ₹701 crore, up 19.9% on the quarter and 222.9% on the year, with consolidated gold-loan AUM of ₹60,640 crore, up 6.4% QoQ and 92.5% YoY. Standalone gross Stage 3 was 1.80% at 30 September, and the standalone LTV slipped to 64.5% from 65.6% in June.
cards.impact: this is the first full set of gold-lender numbers since gold began falling this week, and other gold lenders' Q2 numbers, including Muthoot Fincorp's, will be read against it. Manappuram's gold book grew faster than its tonnage (6.4% against 3.5%), so a good part of the growth came from higher gold prices and bigger tickets, which is the part a falling gold price reverses.

cards.title: Gold hits a 13-month low and AGLOC cuts the 85% ceiling by ₹227 a gram
cards.summary: AGLOC's 85% LTV ceiling for 13 Nov is ₹10,720 a gram, down from ₹10,947 on 12 Nov, on a jewellery reference price of ₹12,612 (was ₹12,879). IBJA's 12 Nov PM rate for 999 gold was ₹1,37,692 per 10 g, and Reuters had spot gold down 2.7% at $3,880.93 an ounce on Thursday afternoon in New York, its lowest since October 2025, as oil rose and traders priced an 87% chance of a December Fed hike.
cards.impact: the industry's 85% per-gram ceiling on fresh gold loans drops by ₹227 from today, the biggest single-day cut this month, and the ceiling is now ₹293 below the 7–11 Nov level. Loans written at last week's ceiling now sit close to their cap.

cards.title: RBI is drafting curbs on private equity control of more than one NBFC, Reuters reports
cards.summary: RBI is working on proposals to stop a private equity firm holding a controlling stake in more than one NBFC, two people told Reuters; holdings of 15% or less would be treated as financial investments with lighter scrutiny. A draft would go out for public consultation, and the rules could be issued early next year, one source said; RBI did not comment.
cards.impact: this is a press report, not an RBI instrument. If it goes through, PE money can still come in as minority stakes of 15% or less, which is the size most IPO anchor and pre-IPO investors take, but a fund that already controls another NBFC couldn't take control of a second one.

cards.title: BusinessLine: Muthoot Fincorp's DRHP shows borrowing cost down 121 bp to 9.11% in FY26
cards.summary: BusinessLine, citing the IPO draft prospectus, reports that Muthoot Fincorp's average cost of borrowing fell to 9.11% in FY26 from 10.32% in FY25, with overseas borrowings at 9.20% of total borrowings in March 2026 (1.65% in March 2024) and commercial paper at 8.92%. It puts bank term loans at 39.69% of borrowings, average loan yield at 21.38% (22.47% in FY25) and net interest margin at 12.80%.
cards.impact: these DRHP numbers are what investors and the press will set against Manappuram's Q2 deck, where consolidated ECB and USD bonds are 19.3% of borrowings.

cards.title: Muthoot Fincorp NCD status
cards.summary: No change since 12 Nov: Muthoot Fincorp's Tranche I NCDs are trading on BSE in the "F" group, and no final allotted amount had appeared in a published source by this morning.
cards.impact: the deemed date of allotment and the final allotted amount had not been seen in a published source as of this edition.

cards.title: Financials lead a flat market; Shriram and Bajaj Finance gain over 3%
cards.summary: The Sensex rose 31.61 points to 81,911.01 and the Nifty 50 gained 0.18% to 25,299.35 on Thursday, while Nifty Financial Services added 1.42% to 28,057.15. Among peers, Shriram Finance closed at ₹1,003.80 (+3.58%), Bajaj Finance at ₹1,115.00 (+3.36%), Muthoot Finance at ₹2,932.90 (+1.13%), Manappuram at ₹319.95 (−0.02%, before its results) and IIFL at ₹663.15 (−0.47%); NSE's provisional data show FIIs net bought ₹7,830.60 crore and DIIs net sold ₹6,331.17 crore.
cards.impact: financials outran the index for a second day even as gold fell, so the market isn't yet marking down lenders for the gold move. The rupee weakened 33 paise to 94.04.

Manappuram Finance Q2 FY27 results
cards.summary: Manappuram's standalone gold-loan AUM rose 6.3% in the quarter to ₹58,097 crore and standalone profit rose 20.5% to ₹665 crore. Standalone gross NPA edged up to 1.8% from 1.6%, while CRAR rose to 22.4%.
cards.impact: Manappuram grew its gold book 6.3% in the quarter while gross NPA rose only slightly and LTV fell, a reference point for Muthoot Fincorp's own Q2 numbers, which fall due by 14 Nov under SEBI LODR Reg 52.

cards.title: Aditya Birla Capital opens its 100th gold-loan branch, targets 1,000+ in three years
cards.summary: Aditya Birla Capital opened its 100th dedicated gold-loan branch, in Santacruz, Mumbai, about three months after entering the business, and repeated its plan for 200–300 branches by March 2027 and more than 1,000 within three years. Its gold-loan AUM was ₹200 crore at 30 September.
cards.impact: another well-funded group lender is building a branch-led gold franchise, starting in Maharashtra, which the release says produced 5.8% of India's gold-loan originations in 2025. It's small today, but it competes for the same branch staff and customers Muthoot Fincorp serves outside Kerala.

latest.summary: Manappuram Finance reported consolidated Q2 FY27 profit of ₹701 crore, up 19.9% on the quarter and 222.9% on the year, with consolidated gold-loan AUM of ₹60,640 crore, up 6.4% QoQ and 92.5% YoY. Stan
